'''Kingstown''' is a town located in the centre of [[Great Kourend]], made up of [[Kourend Castle]], its courtyard, and multiple houses to the east of the courtyard. Here, players can find the houses of the four members of the [[Kourend Council]], although it is not known which council members lives in which house, save [[Councillor Hughes|Sophia Hughes]] before her arrest during the events of [[The Queen of Thieves]].

Outside the councillors’ houses, [[Martin Holt]] and four other [[protester]]s can be seen protesting against the Kourend Council, accusing them of corruption and expressing their desire for a king to rule Great Kourend once more.

The town also has a park east of the councillors’ residences. Here, [[Reshi]], [[Kendall]] and [[Thomdril]], travelling students from the [[College of Bards]] in [[Varlamore]], can be seen camping and playing music. In the nearby pond, players can fish [[salmon]], [[trout]], [[pike]]s and [[sardine]]. A [[Lovakengj Minecart Network]] station operated by [[Hordal]] is located south of the park.

==Treasure Trails==
*Digging in front of the large statue in the centre of Kingstown is the solution to the easy [[cryptic clue]]: ''[[Clue scroll (easy) - Dig in the centre of a great kingdom of 5 cities|Dig in the centre of a great kingdom of 5 cities]].''
